title: Transitivity over a union
statement: Let $s,t$ be sets of integer addresses, and let $m_1,m_2,m_3$ be memories mapping integer addresses to $W$-bit words. If $m_2$ agrees with $m_1$ outside $s$ and $m_3$ agrees with $m_2$ outside $t$, then $m_3$ agrees with $m_1$ outside $s\cup t$.
